mapper.select: SELECT d.id AS id, d.parent_id AS parentId, d.tree_path AS treePath, d.dept_code AS deptCode, d.dept_name AS deptName, d.dept_type AS deptType, d.dept_level AS deptLevel, d.leader_user_id AS leaderUserId, u.real_name AS leaderName, d.status AS status FROM org_department d LEFT JOIN org_user u ON u.id = d.leader_user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE d.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.dept_level ASC, d.dept_name ASC, d.id ASC

SELECT d.id AS id, d.parent_id AS parentId, d.tree_path AS treePath, d.dept_code AS deptCode, d.dept_name AS deptName, d.dept_type AS deptType, d.dept_level AS deptLevel, d.leader_user_id AS leaderUserId, u.real_name AS leaderName, d.status AS status FROM org_department d LEFT JOIN org_user u ON u.id = d.leader_user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 WHERE d.id = #{deptId} AND d.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.employee_no AS employeeNo, u.real_name AS realName, u.avatar_attachment_ref_id AS avatarAttachmentRefId, u.primary_dept_id AS primaryDeptId, d.dept_name AS primaryDeptName, u.position_id AS positionId, p.position_name AS positionName, u.manager_user_id AS managerUserId, m.real_name AS managerName, u.employment_status AS employmentStatus, u.status AS status, COALESCE(pref.signature, '') AS signature, COALESCE(pref.presence_status, 'ONLINE') AS presenceStatus FROM org_user u LEFT JOIN org_department d ON d.id = u.primary_dept_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_position p ON p.id = u.position_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_user m ON m.id = u.manager_user_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN emp_user_preference pref ON pref.user_id = u.id WHERE u.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY d.dept_level ASC, d.dept_name ASC, u.real_name ASC, u.id ASC

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.employee_no AS employeeNo, u.real_name AS realName, u.avatar_attachment_ref_id AS avatarAttachmentRefId, u.primary_dept_id AS primaryDeptId, d.dept_name AS primaryDeptName, u.position_id AS positionId, p.position_name AS positionName, u.manager_user_id AS managerUserId, m.real_name AS managerName, u.employment_status AS employmentStatus, u.status AS status, COALESCE(pref.signature, '') AS signature, COALESCE(pref.presence_status, 'ONLINE') AS presenceStatus FROM org_user u LEFT JOIN org_department d ON d.id = u.primary_dept_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_position p ON p.id = u.position_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_user m ON m.id = u.manager_user_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN emp_user_preference pref ON pref.user_id = u.id WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.employee_no AS employeeNo, u.real_name AS realName, u.gender AS gender, u.mobile AS mobile, a.email AS email, u.avatar_attachment_ref_id AS avatarAttachmentRefId, u.primary_dept_id AS primaryDeptId, d.dept_name AS primaryDeptName, u.position_id AS positionId, p.position_name AS positionName, u.manager_user_id AS managerUserId, m.real_name AS managerName, u.employment_status AS employmentStatus, u.status AS status, u.hire_date AS hireDate, u.regularized_at AS regularizedAt, u.service_start_date AS serviceStartDate, u.annual_leave_start_date AS annualLeaveStartDate, u.work_location AS workLocation FROM org_user u LEFT JOIN org_department d ON d.id = u.primary_dept_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_position p ON p.id = u.position_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_user m ON m.id = u.manager_user_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN auth_user_account a ON a.user_id = u.id AND a.is_deleted = 0 WHERE u.id = #{userId} AND u.is_deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.employee_no AS employeeNo, u.real_name AS realName, u.avatar_attachment_ref_id AS avatarAttachmentRefId, u.primary_dept_id AS primaryDeptId, d.dept_name AS primaryDeptName, u.position_id AS positionId, p.position_name AS positionName, u.manager_user_id AS managerUserId, m.real_name AS managerName, u.employment_status AS employmentStatus, u.status AS status, COALESCE(pref.signature, '') AS signature, COALESCE(pref.presence_status, 'ONLINE') AS presenceStatus FROM org_user u LEFT JOIN org_department d ON d.id = u.primary_dept_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_position p ON p.id = u.position_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_user m ON m.id = u.manager_user_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN emp_user_preference pref ON pref.user_id = u.id WHERE u.primary_dept_id = #{deptId} AND u.id <> #{currentUserId} AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.employment_status <> 'OFFBOARDED' ORDER BY u.real_name ASC, u.id ASC

SELECT u.id AS userId, u.employee_no AS employeeNo, u.real_name AS realName, u.avatar_attachment_ref_id AS avatarAttachmentRefId, u.primary_dept_id AS primaryDeptId, d.dept_name AS primaryDeptName, u.position_id AS positionId, p.position_name AS positionName, u.manager_user_id AS managerUserId, m.real_name AS managerName, u.employment_status AS employmentStatus, u.status AS status, COALESCE(pref.signature, '') AS signature, COALESCE(pref.presence_status, 'ONLINE') AS presenceStatus FROM org_user u LEFT JOIN org_department d ON d.id = u.primary_dept_id AND d.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_position p ON p.id = u.position_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN org_user m ON m.id = u.manager_user_id AND m.is_deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN emp_user_preference pref ON pref.user_id = u.id WHERE u.manager_user_id = #{managerUserId} AND u.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY u.real_name ASC, u.id ASC
